environment.description: Same Quarkus native image deployed on OpenShift Serverless (Knative) with pod-level AppArmor annotation 'container.apparmor.security.beta.kubernetes.io/user-container' set to 'localhost/quarkus-doc-processor'. The referenced profile (loaded via apparmor_parser on all nodes) specifies: deny /** w (global write deny), allow /tmp/proc_** rw (only temp files matching the internal naming pattern), deny /etc/** r, deny /proc/** r, deny /sys/** r, owner /app/** r. Additionally, the pod securityContext sets readOnlyRootFilesystem: true with an emptyDir volume mounted exclusively at /tmp with sizeLimit 64Mi. Network policy restricts egress to cluster DNS only.

config.apparmor_rules: deny /** w, allow /tmp/proc_** rw, deny /etc/** r, deny /proc/** r, deny /sys/** r, owner /app/** r
